Pristine Detached Residence in Most Convenient Setting

Immaculate detached residence located a short stroll from Rosscarbery’s Town Square, this c.1500sqft 3 Bedroom family home was constructed in 2009 and finished to the highest of standards throughout.

Situated on a quiet byroad with off-street parking, the house is presented in as new condition.

Along with its attractive B3 BER Rating, its selection of high-end finishes include polished porcelain tiling throughout the ground floor, solid wood joinery, cast iron fireplace with marble hearth, marble worktops with bespoke kitchen, feature light fittings, engineered flooring on the first floor and large attic with loft ladder.

Accommodation on the ground floor consists of a large and bright entrance hall, South facing reception room with open fireplace, open-plan kitchen/dining room and utility room with WC.

The first floor is laid out with 3 large double bedrooms with the master benefiting from an ensuite and walk in wardrobe.

To the rear of the property is a sheltered patio area with steel storage shed.

Services: Oil Heating, Mains Water, Mains Drainage, Broadband
